title: St Andrews study finds magnetic signature of repeated lightning strikes at Callanish

tellings.quote: research project by the University of St. Andrews where they did a geoysical analysis of a stone circle called the Kanish or Kalinase stone circle

plain: A study by the University of St Andrews in Scotland looked under the ground at the Callanish stone circle, an ancient ring of standing stones, and found a magnetic signature left by lightning striking there again and again. Geoffrey Drumm, a guest who studies ancient sites like the pyramids, summarises the paper himself, as a sign that such old stone sites may have been tied to electricity.
